concern: a new search path could differ from the recorded one, so any floor effect would be partly a code effect
test: A3 re-searched on every click and A1 on click 0 of every ROI; pools, thresholds, template SHA-1s and TP@K must equal the recorded run exactly
result: A3 equal on 294 clicks, A1 on 49
action: the new arms share this code path

concern: the per-ROI b_otsu recomputed here could differ from the recorded floors (float32 rounding, channel drift)
test: exact equality with floors.csv on every ROI before any search
result: b_otsu and b_med equal floors.csv on all 49 ROIs

concern: at high floors the seed template can flatten (SD 0, mass weight <= 0), and a degenerate template would read as a level effect
test: template SD, share of template and kept-box pixels at the floor, and mass weight per click and arm; flagged clicks reported separately
action: flagged clicks listed with their TP@10; read those arms with them in mind

concern: choosing the alternative estimator after seeing outcomes would bias it
test: the alternative is chosen from floor values alone (widest spread of log(b / b_otsu) over clicks), printed and fixed before the search cell runs
result: ALT = W128, chosen by log-ratio SD {'TOTSU': 0.082, 'W128': 0.106, 'W512': 0.079} before the search cell
action: fixed; SFILL kept as a diagnostic only (cell 0)

concern: the non-inferiority margins are mine, so a pass could be an artefact of a generous margin
test: margins fixed in cell 0 as about a third of the clip gain; every CI is reported so a reader can apply another margin
result: margins 1.0 pt and 0.5 mitoses per click; every CI is in contrasts.csv

concern: precision could keep rising with the floor for a reason other than the white surround
test: white-adjacent and other top-10 false positives and M2 per ladder level; precision is compared with where white-FP removal saturates

concern: a non-monotone ladder larger than its CIs is more likely a bug than biology
test: adjacent-level contrasts at K = 10; a sign reversal with both CIs excluding 0 is flagged and investigated

concern: click-centred windows are truncated at the ROI edge, so their effective size varies
test: effective window area per click reported
result: W128: median 1.00, min 0.49 of the nominal area; W512: median 0.95, min 0.30 of the nominal area
action: reported; truncation is part of what the window estimator does on a cropped ROI

concern: a clipped blank could change the self-match picture
test: selfmatch_counts on every list; any top-10 self-match is reported

concern: every arm is scored on the 49 ROIs the clip was found on
test: the level cannot be moved by this sweep (cell 0); a lower level is reported, not adopted
result: all numbers in-sample on the 49 ROIs
action: no level change from this sweep
